title: Voice Intent v2
description: Strict schema for voice intents. Server rejects any payload with fields not defined here.

action.description: The action the user wants to perform

target.description: The agent, service, or resource being acted upon (e.g., 'frontend', 'agent #bf061c')

confidence.description: Model confidence in the intent extraction (0-1)

author.description: User ID from JWT - server overrides any client value

partial.description: True while user is still speaking (speculative intent)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the intent was created

transcript.description: Optional: the text that was converted to this intent
